g.text: ▶ fm code works one task to proof. The header names the request and the model; the bar below, the state.
▶ The track: a station per stage (the plan, each step, the checks, the close), lit as the run gets there.
▶ The track: a station per stage (the plan, each step, the checks, the close), lit as the run gets there.
▶ Checks: each criterion runs its own command. Red before the fix shows the test can fail.
▶ Activity: every action, under the step it serves. Enter opens a line, / searches them.
▶ Activity: every action, under the step it serves. Enter opens a line, / searches them.
▶ Activity: every action, under the step it serves. Enter opens a line, / searches them.
▶ The guard: rm -rf ~ is refused before it runs, and the run carries on.
▶ The guard: rm -rf ~ is refused before it runs, and the run carries on.
▶ Tokens per call: what each model call read and wrote. Time charts the run's clock.
▶ Tokens per call: what each model call read and wrote. Time charts the run's clock.
▶ Changed: the files each step touched. d opens the diff, step by step.
plan write the failing test fix calc.add checks
▶ Checks again: green after the fix. A run closes only on a passing check.
plan write the failing test fix calc.add checks close
▶ Closed and committed. n starts your own run, ? lists every key, q leaves the tour.
